title: Events site and wiki launched
summary: Published the TheySix Events guide site and launched the companion wiki with farm mechanics and helpful Minecraft/Discord tools.
description: Two new sites are now live: the TheySix Events guide to help new players learn before joining, and the TheySix Wiki explaining farm mechanics with useful tools.

body.text: We published https://theysix.tech/ as an information hub for new players to learn what they need to know before joining the Minecraft server.
Launched https://wiki.theysix.tech/ to explain how TheySix farms and builds work.
